newsitem.title: USA: Goody's chairman cuts stake to 58%.
newsitem.headline: Goody's chairman cuts stake to 58%.

text.p: Robert Goodfriend, chairman and chief executive officer for Goody's Family Clothing Inc, said Thursday he reduced his stake in the company to 9,353,455 common shares, or 58 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Goodfriend said he sold 396,150 common shares on October 14 at $13 each.
Although he does not expect to reduce his ownership in the company much further, Goodfriend said he may dispose of additional shares to satisfy his personal financial objectives, the filing said.
